title: Fix the Continue-Before-Increment Bug
description: The program should print odd numbers from 1 to 9.
actualProblem: When i is even, continue jumps straight back to re-check the while condition, skipping the i++ statement. Since i never changes on an even value, the loop gets stuck forever on the first even number it reaches.
explanation: continue skips the remaining loop body for that iteration, including any code that updates the loop variable. Any update that must always happen needs to run before the continue.
